content_of_post_to_answer: What are your daily habits that you feel are a waste of your time and you should not do?
answer: Many habits feel like a waste only after we notice they steal attention from things we value more. The hidden problem is not the habit itself but the lack of a conscious choice behind it. A few minutes of scrolling can be fine; using it to avoid discomfort is what drains time. I explore this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. The biggest time-wasters are often not actions, but automatic decisions we never examine.
